subject: Site coordination clash: site utility trench conflicting with the proposed landscaping

messages.text: Coordination clash identified: site utility trench conflicting with the proposed landscaping layout at Area C, per Utility Plan C-301 vs Sheet C-101. We would like this closed out ahead of the next site work sequence. No cost impact is anticipated. This is holding up site work in this area. A response Friday would be appreciated. This RFI is unrelated to the landscaping allowance reconciliation under separate cover.
